paragraphs.text:
INHERENT JURISDICTION

 REVIEW PETITION (CIVIL) NO.463 OF 2022

 SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CIVIL) NO.1341 OF 2021

 NAGENDRA …Petitioner

 versus

 ASHOK AND ANR. …Respondents

 O R D E R
The order passed by the Trial Court decreeing the suit for specific

 performance was affirmed by the lower appellate court. The second appeal

 arising therefrom was dismissed by the High Court finding no merit in the

 matter.
Special leave petition challenging the decisions of the courts below was

 dismissed by this Court after hearing the counsel.

This review petition is, therefore, dismissed.
………………………………….J.
 [Uday Umesh Lalit]

 ………………………………….J.
 [K. M. Joseph]
New Delhi;
April 20, 2022.
